objectives.statement: Recognize the seven common Bokmål subject pronouns and their English meanings.
Choose a subject pronoun by person and number: speaker, listener, or someone else; one or more than one.
Use subject pronouns at the start of simple Bokmål clauses.

notes: Must teach the Bokmål subject pronouns for first, second, and third person (singular and plural), with simple clause examples. Object pronoun forms and placement belong to the later personal_pronouns_object lesson; reference them only for orientation.
